eva: did a quick sweep this morning on reranker+embedding throughput across regions + CPU vs GPU. posting highlights and config we ran.
perf-bot: nightly-bench job finished: job_id=nb-2026-03-20-07, artifacts at s3://redwood-bench/nb-2026-03-20-07/
sam: top-line: for dims >=1536 GPU still wins 2-5x depending on batch. but for dims 256/384 with very large batches cpu can be competitive (eu-west saw a surprise).
kyle: can you paste the raw numbers? especially c6i vs a10g vs a100.
eva: pasted below (latency per request unless noted). configs: quant=int8-llm (server-side), kernels tested: cutlass, flash_attn, triton_mm. input shape = [batch, seq_len=64, dim]. CPU runs on c6i.24xlarge (48 vcpu). GPU runs: a10g and a100s. region buckets: us-west-2 (aws), eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1.
--- A100 (us-west-2) ---
model rerank-1536 | batch=1  | p50 latency 42ms | tokens/s ~2400
model rerank-1536 | batch=8  | p50 latency 98ms | qps 820 | tokens/s ~6600
quant=int8 -> throughput +1.9x, p50 + slightly higher 10-15ms
kernel=cutlass gave best stable perf, flash_attn slightly lower at small batch but better at batch>=8 for long seqs
--- A10G (eu-west-1) ---
model rerank-1536 | batch=1  | p50 latency 62ms | tokens/s ~1600
model rerank-1536 | batch=8  | p50 latency 150ms | qps 540
int8 gives ~1.6x, int4 unstable on this runtime
--- CPU (eu-west-1 c6i.24xlarge) ---
model rerank-256  | batch=32 | p50 latency 85ms | qps ~370 (per instance)
model rerank-384  | batch=64 | p50 latency 140ms | qps ~420
notes: for dims <=384 and batch>=32 CPU throughput approaches small-GPU (a10g) at cost of latency variance
--- cross-region notes ---
- ap-northeast-1 a10g instances had marginally lower clock (older drivers) -> ~10% perf drop vs eu-us.
- cold KV cache impacts first tokens noticeably; warm-cache runs +5-10% throughput
--- quality ----
- eval: rerank-v2-int8 evaluated on dev-set (2k queries): NDCG@10 delta = -0.8% vs fp16 baseline (within our regression threshold)
- int4 on a100 shows -3.6% NDCG drop; needs targeted eval to be acceptable
--- kernel and runtime tradeoffs ---
- cutlass: best consistent for GEMM-dominant paths (1536 dims). stable across driver versions.
- flash_attn: wins when seq_len >=128 for attention-heavy workloads; beware of padding inefficiencies.
- triton_mm: decent for mixed dims but higher memory overhead; useful for CPU fallback layer.
--- capacity sizing thumb rules (from these runs) ---
- for user-facing reranker 1536/dim targeting 95th p50 <100ms and steady qps: allocate 1 A100 per ~1200 qps (batching tuned to 8)
- for cheaper throughput for bulk offline reranking (dims 256-384): 1 c6i.24xlarge can serve ~400 qps with large batching and relaxed latency
--- commands we ran ---
- ./bench/run_sweep.sh --model rerank-1536 --dims 1536 --batches 1,8,32 --kernels cutlass,flash_attn --quant int8,int4,fp16 --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1
- example runner output snippet: 
  perf: {"region":"eu-west-1","instance":"a10g","batch":8,"p50_ms":150,"qps":540}
